notes: The italicised 'and' at t009 is added: the second לְ phrase carries no waw, and by rule 42's surplus reasoning it is not folded into a neighbouring unit.

אֵין takes the supplied 'came' as its existential predication, since אֵין is the clause's predicate morpheme and rule 20's added-verb case applies only where no morpheme is there to carry it; the unit heads on 'no' under rule 50 and is discontinuous around 'good'.
עֵת takes the indefinite article under rule 15 and its rectum מַרְפֵּה the 'of' under rule 19.
